<!--
Use this template to request removal of a feature from the published per-building
dataset (`site/public/data/per_building_solar_ncr.geojson`). Acknowledged within
5 working days. Feature removed within 14 working days from the next quarterly
release of the dataset.

For an open security advisory (e.g. an active doxxing concern), please use the
GitHub private security advisory form instead:
https://github.com/xmpuspus/solar-map-ph/security/advisories/new
-->

## Which feature?

- OSM way id: `way/...`
- Or lat, lon: `..., ...`
- Or city + nearest landmark: `City — ...`

## Reason for the request

<!-- One or two sentences. Examples: -->
<!-- "The polygon falls on a private residence; the published data identifies it." -->
<!-- "The detection is incorrect (no solar panels at this location)." -->

## Are you the building owner, occupant, or authorized representative?

- [ ] Yes — building owner / occupant
- [ ] Yes — authorized representative (please describe)
- [ ] No — concerned third party (please describe interest)

## Verification (optional)

<!-- A satellite image link or a brief description that lets us confirm. -->

## Preferred response channel

<!-- Reply on this issue (public audit trail) or via email at xpuspus@gmail.com. -->
